name: Snowy Penguin Insulated Bottle
description: Cool Sips All Day! Your chilly buddy featuring premium food-grade stainless steel, double-wall insulation to keep drinks hot & cold for hours, BPA-free safety, and a leak-proof character lid.

name: Ella The Elephant Insulated Bottle
description: Big on Style, Bigger on Hydration! Sip happier everyday with adorable elephant character cap, food-grade stainless steel construction, long-lasting hot & cold thermal retention, and BPA-free design.

name: Shiba Pup Insulated Bottle
description: Playful Sips For Brighter Days! Stay pawsitive and hydrated with cute Shiba Inu 3D cap, bone pattern artwork, vacuum-insulated stainless steel, leak-proof seal, and 100% BPA-free materials.

name: Moo Moo Cow Insulated Bottle
description: Fresh Sips Every Day! Mooo Hydration, Mooore Happiness! Classic spotted cow design with charming 3D cow head lid, food-grade stainless steel, hot & cold temperature preservation, and leak-proof seal.

name: Kitty Delight Insulated Bottle
description: Cute Sips for a Happier You! Stay cute and stay hydrated with feline charm. Double-walled stainless steel keeps drinks at ideal temperature for hours, completely BPA free, safe and 100% leak-proof.

name: Classic Ivory Ribbed Bottle 350ml
description: Compact everyday size with an elegant ribbed tactile finish, beaded easy-carry silicone strap, and leak-proof seal. Perfect for daily hydration with timeless minimalism.

name: Soft Pink Ribbed Bottle 350ml
description: Delicate pastel pink fluted exterior paired with an easy-carry beaded lanyard. Compact 350ml capacity designed for purse, backpack, or desk hydration in style.

name: Cherry Red Ribbed Bottle 350ml
description: Vibrant cherry red finish with ergonomic vertical fluting, reinforced loop handle, and leak-proof twist cap. Bold aesthetics meets practical portability.

name: Lavender Dream Ribbed Bottle 350ml
description: Soothing lavender matte finish with stylish easy-carry loop and textured grip. Lightweight, durable, and crafted for pure sips wherever your day takes you.

name: Bunny Buddy Mint Glass Bottle 330ml
description: Little Moments, Big Stories! I'm reading! mint green compact glass bottle with protective silicone jacket, carry loop, and leak-proof cap. Perfect for school, desk & travel.

name: Cute Rabbit Blush Pink Glass Bottle 330ml
description: It's a Cute Rabbit! Adorable pink glass bottle with charming bunny ear graphics, soft pastel finish, carry loop, and 100% BPA-free hygienic glass construction.

name: Hulu Hulu Peach Glass Bottle 330ml
description: Little Sips, Brighter Days! Warm peach silicone-coated glass bottle featuring whimsical bunny doodles, comfortable carry strap, lightweight compact body, and leak-proof seal.

name: NICE Classic White Glass Bottle
description: Pure Sips, Everyday! Timeless style with brushed stainless steel accent lid, silicone carry strap, temperature retention for hot & cold sips, and BPA-free food-safe glass body.

name: NICE Fresh Mint Glass Bottle
description: Stay Refreshed Naturally! A fresh soothing shade with metallic twist cap, leak-proof silicone gasket, infused water filter compatibility, and versatile gym/office utility.

name: NICE Cool Blue Glass Bottle
description: Chill Sips Anytime, Anywhere! Cool outside, calm inside. Premium borosilicate glass with polished metallic cap, leak-proof design, and dual hot/cold drink compatibility.

name: NICE Blush Pink Glass Bottle
description: Sips of Happiness Everyday! Pretty sips for brighter days with reflective metallic cap, easy-carry silicone strap, BPA-free leak-proof lid, and sleek purse-friendly profile.
